snippet.title: Battle for Bree
snippet.description:
Dark lords forces attack on Bree during the Mume 32. birthday event.
Video depicts a dramatized(little bit edited and postproduced for viewing purposes)
short part of the whole event. 
A Lot of blood was spilled on both sides that day.
Everything one would expect from happening like this was there… blood rushing, trash talking, finger trembling, role-playing, insane battle spam... you name it.

Thats MUME

Big thanks to everybody who showed up! (and was willing to loose all gear- minute of silence for all trolls who sundied that day:( )

Mume is a mud - text based multiplayer rpg which is free to play (no micro, no bs)  https://mume.org/

It is very hard to translate or explain how does it feel to play mud game, so this is my poor attempt with audio-visual finesse to somewhat show how immersive it feels from player view :)
(default game does not have music nor audio effects, you can add those through mudlet client though)


I'm using mudlet client -https://www.mudlet.org/ (with lots of custom scripts)
together with Mume own mmapper https://mume.github.io/MMapper/ (with modded tile set
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1KEpUiW6mVca3Xl7RxpczgZ52AzZh3lTV?usp=sharing )

Discord link for those who are interested in more info https://discord.gg/ckFA4hFA
